qa.overall_assessment: All 5 issues verified. Code review confirms correct data flow for all changes. Browser testing on both desktop (1280x720) and mobile (390x844) confirms working UI. Build succeeded. Issue 1 (Edit sidebar File/Diff tabs) and Issue 2 (AskUserQuestion persistence) are code-correct but cannot be fully E2E tested because existing sessions predate the CLI enrichment changes. Issues 3, 4, 5 confirmed working in browser.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Issue 1: Edit tool shows full file content in sidebar with File/Diff tabs
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code review of sessionProtocolMapper.ts (enrichToolResultOutput function), fileContentReader.ts, and SidebarFileView.tsx (File/Diff tab implementation)
success_criteria_results.details: CLI sessionProtocolMapper correctly calls enrichToolResultOutput which reads file at input.file_path for Edit/Write tools via readFileContentForToolEnd (capped at 100KB). SidebarFileView.tsx has File/Diff tabs that show when hasFileContent returns true (result > 100 chars with newlines). Tab bar renders File and Diff buttons with active state styling. File tab uses SimpleSyntaxHighlighter, Diff tab uses ToolDiffView.
evidence: sessionProtocolMapper.ts line 54-72: enrichToolResultOutput reads file content for FILE_CONTENT_TOOLS
fileContentReader.ts: FILE_CONTENT_TOOLS = Set(['Edit', 'Write']), readFileContentForToolEnd with 100KB cap
SidebarFileView.tsx lines 42-77: File/Diff tab bar with active state, conditional rendering based on hasFileContent
Browser: Sidebar opens on Edit tool click showing file path and diff view (no File tab because pre-fix session data has short result string)

success_criteria_results.criterion: Issue 2: AskUserQuestion answers persist permanently via agentState
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Code review of permissionHandler.ts, reducer.ts, storageTypes.ts, ops.ts, AskUserQuestionView.tsx
success_criteria_results.details: Complete data flow verified: (1) CLI permissionHandler.ts line 463 includes answers in completedRequests agentState, (2) App reducer.ts lines 492-529 copies answers in needsUpdate check, new permission creation, and permission update, (3) storageTypes.ts line 71 has answers: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).nullish() in AgentStateSchema.completedRequests, (4) permissionAnswersStore removed from ops.ts (grep returns no matches), (5) getPermissionAnswers import removed from AskUserQuestionView.tsx (grep returns no matches), (6) AskUserQuestionView.tsx line 272 uses (tool.result as any)?.answers ?? tool.permission?.answers for recovery
evidence: ops.ts: permissionAnswersStore REMOVED (grep confirms no matches)

success_criteria_results.criterion: Issue 3: Subagent sidebar isUuidLike reverted to original
success_criteria_results.details: reducerTracer.ts line 117-119 has isUuidLike with original UUID regex pattern. Line 285 uses isUuidLike check for non-UUID parent references to treat them as standalone messages.
evidence: reducerTracer.ts:117-119: isUuidLike function with standard UUID regex

success_criteria_results.verification_method: Browser verification on both desktop and mobile viewports
success_criteria_results.details: Bash tool calls in dev session correctly show truncated output with '+N more lines' indicators. Deploy commands show '+10 more lines', commit commands show '+12 more lines' and '+19 more lines'. Commands are horizontally scrollable, not wrapping.
evidence: Screenshot qa-desktop-bash-truncation.png: Deploy tool shows 2 lines + '+10 more lines'
Screenshot qa-mobile-session-view.jpeg: Mobile view shows same truncation, no layout overflow
Accessibility tree confirms: '+10 more lines', '+12 more lines', '+19 more lines', '+3 more lines', '+1 more lines' visible in session

success_criteria_results.criterion: Issue 5: Detail page sidebar closes when navigating

evidence: Screenshot qa-desktop-edit-sidebar.png: Detail page shows Edit tool details, no sidebar visible
Navigation: Click tool name -> detail page (no sidebar) -> back button -> session list (no sidebar)

Issue 2: answers flow through agentState -> server -> completedRequests -> reducer -> permission -> view recovery. Local Map removed. Issue 3: isUuidLike restored. Issue 4: Previously confirmed working. Issue 5: Previously confirmed working.
